materials.vertexShader: varying vec3 vLocal;varying vec3 vNormal;varying vec3 vView;void main(){vLocal=position;vNormal=normalize(normalMatrix*normal);vec4 mv=modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.);vView=normalize(-mv.xyz);gl_Position=projectionMatrix*mv;}

materials.fragmentShader: varying vec3 n;varying vec3 v;void main(){float f=pow(1.-abs(dot(normalize(n),normalize(v))),5.);gl_FragColor=vec4(.22,.48,1.,f*.28);}
